subject.title: fix: stop node alerts replaying after Gateway restart

question: Can this PR remove the legacy `client.instanceId` pairing metadata path, or must it preserve/explicitly migrate that lookup for upgraded node-pairing records?
rationale: The branch changes persisted pairing-record lookup semantics, and the PR-body assertion about migration coverage needs an explicit maintainer judgment or independently demonstrated compatibility contract before landing.

options.title: Prove and preserve the upgrade contract
options.body: Add focused coverage showing migration canonicalizes every supported legacy alias before the claim, or retain the legacy lookup until that migration is complete.

options.title: Accept canonical-only behavior
options.body: Explicitly accept that legacy alias-only pairing records will no longer receive the prior metadata update and document the supported upgrade boundary.

recommendation.title: Prove and preserve the upgrade contract
recommendation.body: Add focused coverage showing migration canonicalizes every supported legacy alias before the claim, or retain the legacy lookup until that migration is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed pairing lifecycle and supplied the current identity-contract rationale.
